title: Final Commutator Result
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly show that [J_x^2, J_y^2] = [J_y^2, J_z^2] = [J_z^2, J_x^2].

title: Commutator Vanishing for j=0 and j=1/2
description: Essential Criteria: The student must demonstrate that the commutators vanish for states where j = 0 or j = 1/2.

title: Eigenbasis for j=1
description: Important Criteria: The student must find and state the common eigenbasis of J_x^2, J_y^2, and J_z^2 for j = 1.

title: Correct Application of Commutators
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the properties of commutators and the angular momentum algebra.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect assumptions about the symmetry of the operators or miscalculating the commutators.
